method: Primary assistant directly inspected all ten numbered contact sheets, then two enlarged six-image sheets. Same-reviewer check, not independent validation. No model predictions or labels from other photos were used.

corrections.reason: Shirt bunching and hand placement obscure independent waist taper.
Wide sleeves and full skirt leave only disconnected forearm and knee fragments.
Dress drape and loose sleeve folds conceal contours; boots hide legs.
Larger view resolves moderate arm and trunk breadth rather than a narrow impression.
